summary: Add a mirrored two-consumer control for production journal pruning with the primary root behind the follower.

replay.detail: Fixture-only control; no startup replay or backfill.

schema.detail: No production SQL, DDL, index, trigger, migration or dependency change.

rules.detail: The unchanged Installer chooses the cutoff; the fixture passes no minimum and retains all 32 images.

compatibility.detail: One authored, unrun A16/B32 control checks prune16 then0, original-reference catchup and independent complete state/native output parity. With the opposite ordering it rejects fixed-consumer selection, not arbitrary registry minima. All earlier prefixes, helpers, assertions and ceilings stay unchanged; no savings or adoption claim.

manual.detail: No configuration, activation or nextest change.

recovery.detail: No fault hook, retry or cleanup policy. Two-consumer crash/reopen, image reclamation, work/hold/CPU, unsafe cleanup, source lifetime and authority remain deferred.
